title: File:Yagcı bedir halısı.jpg
desc: In the Sındırgı district of Balıkesir province of Türkiye, sheep wool yarns dyed with root dyes are woven on hand-woven carpet and rug looms with motifs and patterns belonging to the Yörük culture. The weaving of these carpets and rugs is done knot by knot, providing a family or a woman with a livin
